title: Moses’ Birth and Early Life

questions.question: Who hid her son in a basket among the reeds by the Nile?
questions.explanation: Exodus 2:2-3 (ESV): "The woman conceived and bore a son... When she could hide him no longer... she took for him a basket... and put the child in it."

questions.question: Who found and adopted the baby in the basket?
questions.explanation: Exodus 2:5-6 (ESV): "Now the daughter of Pharaoh came down to bathe at the river... She saw the basket... and took pity on him."

questions.question: Where did Moses flee after killing the Egyptian?
questions.explanation: Exodus 2:15 (ESV): "When Pharaoh heard of it, he sought to kill Moses. But Moses fled from Pharaoh and stayed in the land of Midian."

questions.question: Who did Moses marry in Midian?
questions.explanation: Exodus 2:21 (ESV): "And Moses was content to dwell with the man, and he gave Moses his daughter Zipporah."

questions.question: What was the name of Moses' first son?
questions.explanation: Exodus 2:22 (ESV): "She gave birth to a son, and he called his name Gershom, for he said, 'I have been a sojourner in a foreign land.'"

questions.question: What did Moses do when he saw an Egyptian beating a Hebrew?
options: Killed the Egyptian and hid him in the sand
questions.correctAnswer: Killed the Egyptian and hid him in the sand
questions.explanation: Exodus 2:11-12 (ESV): "He saw an Egyptian beating a Hebrew... He struck down the Egyptian and hid him in the sand."

questions.question: Who watched over Moses' basket from a distance?
questions.explanation: Exodus 2:4 (ESV): "And his sister stood at a distance to know what would be done to him."

questions.question: What did Miriam offer to do for Pharaoh's daughter?
options: Take the child to Egypt's temple
Find a Hebrew nurse for the baby
questions.correctAnswer: Find a Hebrew nurse for the baby
questions.explanation: Exodus 2:7 (ESV): "Then his sister said to Pharaoh's daughter, 'Shall I go and call you a nurse from the Hebrew women to nurse the child for you?'"

questions.question: Who was sought by Miriam to nurse the baby Moses?
questions.explanation: Exodus 2:8 (ESV): "So the girl went and called the child's mother."

questions.question: What did Moses help Jethro's daughters do at the well?
options: Water their flock after driving away shepherds
questions.correctAnswer: Water their flock after driving away shepherds
questions.explanation: Exodus 2:17 (ESV): "The shepherds came and drove them away, but Moses stood up and saved them, and watered their flock."

questions.question: What was the name of Zipporah's father?
questions.explanation: Exodus 2:18 (ESV): "When they came home to their father Reuel..." Also known as Jethro (Exodus 3:1).

questions.question: What material was the basket made of that held baby Moses?
questions.explanation: Exodus 2:3 (ESV): "When she could hide him no longer, she took for him a basket made of bulrushes and daubed it with bitumen and pitch."

questions.question: How many daughters did the priest of Midian have?
questions.explanation: Exodus 2:16 (ESV): "Now the priest of Midian had seven daughters."

questions.question: According to Exodus 2:23-24, what did God remember when the Israelites cried out?
options: His covenant with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob
questions.correctAnswer: His covenant with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob
questions.explanation: Exodus 2:24 (ESV): "And God heard their groaning, and God remembered his covenant with Abraham, with Isaac, and with Jacob."

questions.question: What does the name "Gershom" mean, and why did Moses name his son this?
options: "God helps" - because God helped him escape
"Sojourner there" - because he was a stranger in a foreign land
"Firstborn" - because he was the first son
questions.correctAnswer: "Sojourner there" - because he was a stranger in a foreign land
questions.explanation: Exodus 2:22 (ESV): "She gave birth to a son, and he called his name Gershom, for he said, 'I have been a sojourner in a foreign land.'"

key_verse_text: When the child grew older, she brought him to Pharaoh’s daughter, and he became her son. She named him Moses, ‘Because,’ she said, ‘I drew him out of the water.’
